get.description: This operation allows a consumer to fetch a more verbose state of the process, and will give an indication of whether the new business onboarding resulted in a "Go", "No go", or a "Wait" if the process is still running. If there are certain validation errors where the consumer is required to update a workflows data, this information will be made available in this response.

post.description: This operation can be used to initiate a new business onboarding workflow with XOB Actimize, or LIS. The middleware will handle the processing with the XOB Actimize API and provide the consumer with asynchronous notifications of where in the process the workflow is. The consumer can use these notifications to determine whether or not to fetch more information about the current state of the process through the GET operation.
